requirements.text: The ODPTV model has a Technology Object.
Implementation implements the technology object class.
The Implementable standard implements or extends the technology object.
Implementation Class. IXIT extends Implementation Class on a 0 to many basis.
IXIT Class. Implementation extends IXIT on a 0 to many basis.
A class ImplementableStandard. TechnologyObject extends ImplementableStandard on a 1 to many basis.
